answer:
Yes—**it appears suitable for sensitive baby skin**, assuming you mean the **Cloud Moist Baby Wipes / Cloud Wipes 3-Pack** listing. The product is described as **hypoallergenic**, **unscented/fragrance-free**, **alcohol-free**, **dermatologist-tested**, and recommended for **sensitive skin**; it’s also listed as **99% purified water** with plant-based fibers. ([target.com](https://www.target.com/p/-/A-1006780196))

The listed ingredients are relatively simple: **water, sodium citrate, gluconolactone, glycerin, sodium benzoate, citric acid, and disodium EDTA**. The brand also says the wipes are made without **fragrance, alcohol, parabens, formaldehyde, latex, allergens, or chlorine processing**. ([bcbabycare.com](https://www.bcbabycare.com/products/cloud-moist-baby-wipe?variant=46984901460214))

**Caveat:** “Hypoallergenic” doesn’t guarantee that every baby won’t react. If your baby has eczema, an active rash, broken skin, or known sensitivities, test on a small area first and stop use if redness or irritation appears. The National Eczema Association similarly notes that people with eczema/sensitive skin should check ingredients for possible triggers and ask a healthcare provider when unsure. ([nationaleczema.org](https://nationaleczema.org/eczema-products/cloud-skin-soft-wipe/))
